releaseGates.gate: Complete P0 and P1 interactive journey on this exact packaged candidate
releaseGates.reason: Service and browser fixtures do not establish native dialogs, clipboard, permissions, actual microphone/audio devices, and interactive restore. Record separate UI/device evidence.
Review the separate benchmark evidence and actual usable-shell timings; this aggregate runner does not promote timing targets.

releaseGates.gate: Installation on a separate clean Mac
releaseGates.reason: Minimal PATH and empty-model-cache execution on this development host is not a clean-machine installation.
The automated candidate build uses an ad-hoc signature.

releaseGates.gate: Full P1 scope and optional live integration qualification
releaseGates.reason: Package limits and optional integration states are explicit. Fixture results do not close missing product breadth or live account/device evidence.

limitations: Automated success produces a personal-use release candidate; full P1 release approval remains withheld until open acceptance gates are resolved.
Browser suites use service fixtures. Packaged journeys execute real services and native helpers, but do not substitute for interactive dialogs/clipboard/screenshot/audio observations.
Native audio lifecycle uses synthetic PCM/public speech; general meeting and every new AI mode quality are not established.
Managed providers and remote MCP stay disabled. No credentials, account sign-in or network fallback are introduced by qualification.
Ad-hoc signed macOS arm64 candidate; separate clean-Mac installation and public notarization remain unverified.

4A.name: Advanced editing
4A.limits: Rich nested layout controls and native clipboard/device interactions need separate observation.

4B.name: Advanced databases
4B.limits: Only the published formula subset is supported; no proprietary formula parity claim.

4C.name: Migration and export
4C.limits: Notion live-account capture and complete database/schema/view API reconstruction are not qualified. PDF is a readable rendition.

4D.name: Capture and external indexes
4D.limits: Browser paste/share and approved-root indexing are local. Native screenshot permission/UI and AST parity remain unqualified.

4E.name: Local automation
4E.limits: Runs while Trove is open. UI exposes a subset of service actions. No remote side effects.

4F.name: Expanded local AI
4F.limits: Draft validation and evidence boundaries are qualified by fixtures; general output quality for every P1 mode is not established.

4G.name: Optional provider adapters
4G.limits: Paired loopback MCP only; managed Claude Code/Codex and remote MCP remain disabled.

optionalIntegrations.name: Paired local MCP
optionalIntegrations.qualification: local protocol, cancellation, scope and reviewed mutation fixtures; requires app running and renewed pairing after restart

optionalIntegrations.name: Notion API capture
optionalIntegrations.qualification: fixture-qualified page/block capture only; live account and full database API parity unverified

optionalIntegrations.name: Managed Claude Code
